name: Workplace from Meta
description: Workplace from Meta was an enterprise communication and collaboration service that Meta discontinued and fully shut down in May 2026.
agentUseSummary: Workplace from Meta is unavailable because Meta has fully shut down the product. Legacy developer documentation does not provide a current service to authorize, connect, read, write, administer, export, or revoke, so Relay exposes no credential, connection, capability, action, wrapper, or runtime adapter.

blocked.label: Connect Workplace
blocked.description: Meta fully shut Workplace down on May 31, 2026, so there is no current service or authorization lifecycle to connect.

blocked.label: Use legacy Workplace APIs
blocked.description: Retained historical documentation and Graph API vocabulary must not be represented as a live or callable Workplace integration.

blocked.label: Access Workplace data
blocked.description: Communities, groups, posts, comments, members, chats, bots, webhooks, administration, exports, and every read or write are unavailable.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No actions can be enabled for a discontinued provider product.

runtimeSupport.description: A fully discontinued Workplace service cannot be mounted as OpenClaw tools.
A fully discontinued Workplace service cannot be mounted as Hermes tools.

providerSetup.blocker: Meta ended normal Workplace operation in August 2025 and fully shut the product down on May 31, 2026.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request credentials or show Connect. Reconsider only if Meta launches a new Workplace product with a current production API and delegated authorization contract; migration to another provider would be a separate integration.

evidence.supports: The official Workplace URL redirects to Meta's end-of-life page stating that Workplace closed in May 2026.
Meta's official discontinuation update states normal service ended August 31, 2025, followed by read/download-only access until full shutdown on May 31, 2026.
The retained developer location is historical documentation and does not restore a current Workplace product after the official shutdown.
